title: Accepting computation check
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $w$ be a Boolean list. The predicate holds exactly when $w$ is a valid check for input length $|x|$ and time parameter $s$, and scanning the prefix of $w$ of length $W(N)(2s+1)$ yields the terminal scan result $(	ext{none},1)$.
